newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday. Bids and offers included;
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River (McGregor and south), next week bid at 115 percent, offered at 122-1/2 percent, no comparisons.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (St. Paul through Savage) next week bid at 140 percent, no offer or comparisons.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week July, bid 2-1/2 points lower at 105 percent, offered at 115 percent.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week August, bid at 120 percent, offered at 130 percent, no comparisons.
- Ten barges, Illinois River, two each week August, bid 2-1/2 points lower at 115 percent, offered at 120 percent.
- Four barges, Mississippi River (Osceola through Cairo), one each week October, offered at a steady 200 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week December, bid at 160 percent, 10 points below previous offer, no offer.
